summary: With-trend engulfing at a level after a pullback (continuation); enter after it closes.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: trading the engulfing bar pattern with the trend is the easiest way to make money in the market.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: your first rule is to follow the market direction

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: When a bullish engulfing candle forms in the context of an uptrend, it indicates a continuation signal.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Your ability to identify an engulfing candlestick at a key level in a clear uptrend or downtrend will greatly enhance the probabilities of making a wining trade.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: we simply buy when price pullbacks to the moving average and an engulfing bar pattern forms.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if you see an engulfing bar pattern matches up with 50% or 61 % levels, it is a powerful price action trading signal

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Take an order immediately after the price action signal forms, put your stop loss below the candlestick pattern

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: This reversal candlestick pattern consists of two opposite colored bodies in which the second body engulfs or covers entirely the first one

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: the first body is entirely engulfed by the second one.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The second real body is the opposite of the first real body.

not_used.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
not_used.quote: The engulfing bar can engulf more than one previous candle, but to be considered an engulfing bar, at least one candle must be fully consumed.

not_used.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
not_used.quote: The color of the bodies is not important.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: if the market is making series of higher highs and higher lows it is about an uptrend market

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: using the moving average as a dynamic support and resistance in trending markets, in combination with an engulfing bar pattern signal is the perfect way
